profiles.name: Loom
profiles.why: Loom's own pages promise a team-wide, AI-assisted video-messaging platform with libraries, viewer insights and enterprise security (loom.com/pricing), while Screen Studio's verified claims center on cinematic, cursor-synced screen recording and locally processed voice cleanup specifically for polished demo videos (E3, E2, E9). Both tools let someone 'record and share a video,' but Loom's documented strength is organization-wide async communication at scale, not the frame-by-frame editing effects Screen Studio documents, so a team already paying for Loom is not shown here to have that same capability duplicated.
profiles.discovery_reason: The async video tool many teams already pay for, so adding Screen Studio means justifying a second subscription for the same 'record and share a video' job
profiles.one_liner: Easily record and share AI-powered video messages with your teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
profiles.promise: One video is worth a thousand words — record and share AI-powered video messages with teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
profiles.pricing: Starter plan $0; Business $18 per user/month; Business + AI $24 per user/month; Enterprise custom pricing (Let's Talk, contact sales); annual billing available saving up to 17%
profiles.free_entry: Starter plan at $0 via sign up, described as 'Get started with video communication'
profiles.icp: Teams and individuals across Sales, Engineering, Customer support, Design, and Product management use cases, from startups to enterprises (400,000 companies)
profiles.note: 5 claim(s) the extractor reported were not on their pages and were discarded
